description: Counterparty check in one call. Send a company or person name, a domain, an EVM wallet address, or any mix; returns one report with a status per check: OFAC sanctions (name and wallet), SEC EDGAR and GLEIF company records (name), domain registration, DNS and TLS, and email authentication (domain); each check that returns data cites sources and retrieval times. Use before paying or onboarding a party. A screening aid, not a compliance determination. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.03 (USDC, x402).

address.description: EVM wallet address: exact sanctions match. Send at least one field.

domain.description: Domain name: registration, DNS, TLS and email authentication checks.

name.description: Company or person name: sanctions screen, SEC and GLEIF lookups.
